title.narrative: S&T Cluster Conference - Participation of a panellist from Norway

description.narrative: The PSA office is hosting an international conference in New Delhi on 4-5 December, 2025, to enhance the global connectivity of the S&T Clusters. This conference will serve as a platform for showcasing the technological solutions developed by the clusters while also fostering opportunities for international collaborations and joint ventures with similar clusters and organizations worldwide. Norway also has good experience of working in a cluster approach. The Embassy therefore decided to participate in the conference as it will facilitate exchange of ideas and innovations and strengthen global scientific partnerships. The Embassy will participate in two panel discussions, including special remarks by the Ambassador. The Embassy will also show-case some relevant Norway-India collaboration activities, through an exhibit. A panellist from Norway will be supported for participation in one of the sessions.
